# Inverted Tower

Type: Structure | Internal ID: SwampWell1 | MountainWell1 | Location: Swamp, ,, Mountain | Resources: Mountain Chest | Inhabitants: Draugr elite, (Swamp)

# Introduction

Inverted Towers or Wells are Points of interest found in Swamp and Mountain. These are circular structures with staircases leading down into the ground.

## Swamp

Swamp Inverted Towers are often flooded with water. Up to two Draugr elites, with a 32.1% chance each, can emerge from water. They have no particular resources.

## Mountain

Inverted Towers in the mountain are not protected. They have a 75% chance for a Mountain Chest at the bottom of the well.
